statement: Find the smallest possible value of $\left\lfloor\dfrac{a+b+c}{d}\right\rfloor + \left\lfloor\dfrac{b+c+d}{a}\right\rfloor + \left\lfloor\dfrac{c+d+a}{b}\right\rfloor + \left\lfloor\dfrac{d+a+b}{c}\right\rfloor$ where $a, b, c, d$ vary over the positive integers.

Let $k \geq 1$. We have $4k$ chips, $2k$ red and $2k$ blue. A \textit{move} interchanges some consecutive red chips with an equal number of consecutive blue chips. Determine the smallest $n$ (as a function of $k$) such that from any initial arrangement, at most $n$ moves suffice to place the first $2k$ chips all red.
Find all integers $n \geq 2$ with the following property: for each pair of positive divisors $k, \ell < n$, at least one of $2k - \ell$ and $2\ell - k$ is also a divisor of $n$.

Let $ABCD$ be a square. Let $P$ be a variable interior point with $\angle BAP \geq 60^\circ$. Let $Q$ be the intersection of line $AD$ and the perpendicular to $BP$ at $P$. Let $R$ be the intersection of line $BQ$ and the perpendicular to $BP$ from $C$.

a) Prove that $|BP| \geq |BR|$.

b) For which points $P$ does equality hold?
